channel.title: Easy Paint Pro
channel.description: Updates for Easy Paint Pro for Mac.

item.title: Version 3.5.0 (92)
item.description:
• 27 new stamps, and a rebuilt 3D gallery with crisp 3D objects and letters and optional shadows.
  • A new Text panel: sizes from 1 to 1,638 px with a slider, inline styles and sharper text edges.
  • Placed objects resize from their handles and stay sharp next to Behind artwork.
  • Sketch styles for the Brush, side-by-side Brush size and opacity, and a faster Eraser.
  • Steadier canvas: tighter margins, no jumping while you edit text, and movable canvas controls.
  • Larger Classic Retro tool art, and a skin switch beside Record.

item.title: Version 3.5.0
item.description:
• Tab groups, like Chrome: name and colour a group, drag it, and fold it away.
  • A toolbar that fits your screen: the drawing tools scroll or pull down into two or three rows.
  • Icons Only: hide the names under the toolbar buttons for bigger icons.
  • Hide the toolbar for more canvas, or pin it (View ▸ Pin Toolbar).
  • Fit to Screen, and the canvas stays where it is when you zoom or crop.

item.title: Version 3.4.2
item.description:
• Try every tool free for 7 days, then buy once at easypaintpro.com.
  • License keys activate on 1 Mac and can move to another one.
  • New toolbar choices: Two Rows, Fit Window and sizes up to 150%.
  • The Classic colour schemes have new names.
